steps.code:
# Fetch details for each unique song and collect artist names
song_artists = {}  # song_id -> list of artist names
for sid in all_song_ids:
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    artists = [a['name'] for a in song['artists']]
    song_artists[sid] = artists
print(song_artists)

steps.code:
# Count songs per artist (each song counts once per artist it belongs to)
from collections import Counter
artist_counts = Counter()
for artists in song_artists.values():
    for artist in artists:
        artist_counts[artist] += 1
print(artist_counts)
